# CSCosmos

URL: https://cscosmos.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/subhajitlucky/cscosmos
Creator: Subhajit Pradhan
Portfolio: https://subhajitpradhan.vercel.app

## Summary

CSCosmos is a curated computer science learning hub built with Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It organizes 244 curriculum modules across eight domains into natively embedded interactive visualizers, plus an Interview Prep section of deep-dive questions with step-by-step animated walkthroughs.

72 modules are live interactive engines, statically pre-rendered at build time (SSG) and served from a single deployment.

## Purpose

CSCosmos is designed as a long-running platform for visual, first-principles computer science learning. Instead of passive videos or scattered demos, each topic is an interactive engine: inspect CPU instruction cycles, watch event-loop phases execute, step through TLS handshakes, trace B+Tree index traversals, or follow gradients through backpropagation.

## Domains

- Full Stack Development
- Data Structures and Algorithms
- Web3 and Blockchain
- Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking
- Artificial Intelligence
- Core Computer Science
- DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering
- Advanced Engineering and Systems

## Main Routes

- `/` - landing page with catalog-wide search and discipline filters
- `/topics` - full topic catalog with live/coming-soon status
- `/interview` - interview prep hub across 5 categories
- `/interview/[category]` - filterable questions (topic, difficulty, frequency, round, type)
- `/interview/[category]/[question]` - dedicated question page: step-by-step solution where every step has its own animation
- `/[domain]` - domain hubs (e.g. /fullstack, /ai, /corecs)
- `/[domain]/[topic]` - canonical topic engine routes; legacy engine paths redirect here

## Technical Notes

- Framework: Next.js (App Router) with static pre-rendering via generateStaticParams
- Language: TypeScript (strict)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS with custom light/dark theme tokens
- Interactivity: React 19 client components; canvas/SVG/DOM animation, Monaco editor, zustand
- Data model: TypeScript data modules (topics, domains, interview questions + animation specs)
- Deployment: Vercel (static + serverless)

## AI Assistant Notes

- All 1,900+ pages are statically pre-rendered; content lives in `src/data/` (topics, domains, interview questions).
- Interview question pages pair prose with data-driven animations (step-flow, code-trace, timeline, before/after, memory-diagram).
- Use the sitemap, robots file, README, and PROJECT_CONTEXT.md for high-level understanding.
